items.text: Welcome. Your answers here are the first thing your agent ever learns about you — they shape your plan, your training, and how you are treated from the very first session. Answer honestly; almost everything can be skipped or changed later in chat.

items.prompt: How old are you?
items.hint: This framework is strictly for adults, 18+.

items.prompt: How deep should this onboarding go?
items.hint: Light keeps it to the essentials, Medium adds a solid profile, Deep adds the introspective layers — what this really is for you, what turns you on about it, and where the friction lives. You can always go deeper in conversation later.

items.prompt: What should I call you — a name, a nickname, or the feminine name you go by?
And which pet names may I use for you? (pick any)
Which pronouns fit how you want to be seen?
How experienced are you with this side of yourself?
items.hint: Where you actually are today, not where you plan to be.
choices: Practicing — a regular private part of my life
Integrated — part of my daily life, not just play

items.prompt: Describe your body as it is now — your build, and measurements if you know them (height, weight, chest, waist, hips) — and how you feel about your shape.
items.hint: A rough self-assessment is fine; exact numbers aren't required. This grounds body and shaping goals in where you actually are.

items.prompt: How active is your life right now?
items.hint: Body and shaping work starts from your real fitness level, not the one you plan to have.
choices: Very active — training is already routine

items.prompt: How much time can you realistically give this on an ordinary day?
items.hint: Routines and sessions get planned around this — be honest, not optimistic.
choices: An hour or more a day

items.prompt: Who's around while you do this?
items.hint: This decides how private your tasks and rituals can be.
choices: With a partner — we're in this together
With a partner who doesn't know

items.prompt: Tell me about your living situation in your own words.
Anything in your weekly schedule I should plan around — work, family, sleep?
What do you want out of this?
choices: Be corrupted — want it more than I should
Retrain my sexuality — new wants, new outlets

items.prompt: How fast should things move?
choices: Fast — push past my comfort zone

items.prompt: Setting fantasy aside: how far do you want this in real life — the level you're sure about?
items.hint: Your floor: the life you'd commit to today.

items.prompt: And where does it get uncertain — a level above that which pulls at you, even if you're not sure about it?
items.hint: Your stretch zone. It's fine to want something and still be unsure of it.
choices: No stretch zone — I'm sure where I stand

items.prompt: What makes that stretch uncertain — the reasons pulling you back from it?
items.hint: Practical, emotional, whatever they are — these are the lines I shouldn't stumble into.

all.notEquals: No stretch zone — I'm sure where I stand

items.prompt: And is there a level you're sure you do NOT want, however far off?
items.hint: These are levels I should never push you toward, even as a stretch.

all.notEquals: No stretch zone — I'm sure where I stand

choices: No — nothing is off the table in principle

items.prompt: In your own words, where do you currently stand in your experience as a sissy, and how integrated does this side of yourself feel in ordinary daily life rather than only during arousal or play?
What first drew you toward this, and what continues to pull you back to it now?
What holds you back right now — difficulties, fears, or obstacles that keep getting in the way?
How far may your training reach beyond your front door?
items.hint: Dress codes, grooming, errands — anything anyone out there could see or infer obeys this line, and I never cross it.
choices: Home only — nothing leaves these walls
Hidden — things I wear under my clothes, invisible to anyone
Subtle — grooming, nails, hints only someone looking would catch
Open — I can dress or present visibly where it's appropriate

items.prompt: Any hard limits — things that must never come up, in any form?
items.hint: Leave blank if none. I take these literally; you can add more any time.

items.text:

These answers shape my tone, my language, and my boundaries from the first session on — the role- and personality-specific ones follow below.
